question: Who is the General Secretary of Communist Party of India as of January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is **__D.Raja.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Communist Party of India was formed on **25 December 1925**.
 
• It is one of the **oldest parties** and one of the **national parties** of our nation.
 
• **S.V. Ghate** was the** first General Secretary of the Communist Party of India(CPI)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Brinda karat**

 
 
• **​**She is an Indian politician and an **elected member to the Rajya Sabha as a Communist Party of India member on 11 April 2005 for West Bengal**.
 
• In 2005, she became the** first woman member of the CPI Politburo**.
 
 
 
• **Suravaram Sudhakar Reddy**
 
 
• **​**He is the** former General Secretary of the Communist Party of India from 2012 to 2019**.
 
• He was a member of the **12th and 14th Lok Sabha of India and represented the Nalgonda constituency of Telangana.**
